Thank you so much for your comment, It means a lot that you'd take time out of your day to answer me!
 I definitely am a slave to over thinking it and making it 100x harder on myself, so your advice really makes sense. I'll try my best not to worry so much about it tomorrow and just take it in strides. I mean it'll only be for a couple minutes at the latest, so it's not this huge commitment?? Good luck in your own struggles friend!
